subject: Pilot extension and conditional packaging proposal
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@lumenhealth.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot extension and packaging options

Hi Sofia,

Quick note from Lumen's AI team — we're mid-eval and the clinical review board has delayed sign-off by about two weeks. That means our engineering window moved and we'd like to request an extension to the pilot.

Two constraints from procurement:
- We need a short amendment (no pricing surprises) that our procurement team can sign quickly.
- Any extension needs to avoid a material increase in cost for us; if there's a surcharge, we need an offset (credits or waived fees).

Can you share what flexible options Redwood offers? Specifically: short extensions, SKU swaps (lower concurrency/longer runtime), or credits tied to usage milestones. We want something that keeps the pilot momentum without re-running procurement.

Thanks — I can loop in our procurement lead if needed.

Elena Park
Head of AI, Lumen Health
elena.park@lumenhealth.io
+1 415-555-0198
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@lumenhealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot extension and packaging options

Elena — thanks for the heads up and totally understandable. We can accommodate a short runway extension; below are three practical options we commonly use. I attached v1 of a short amendment you can share with procurement.

Options (pick one or tell me which two you prefer):

1) Two-week extension (no change in SKU) — automatic, no fee, plus a $1,000 service credit applied against next invoice.

2) Three-week extension with SKU swap — move to a lower-concurrency, longer-duration SKU. Price is reduced 20% for timeboxed hours; Redwood will waive the standard change fee. This is good if you want steady throughput with lower peak concurrency.

3) Four-week extension with performance milestone credit — we extend 4 weeks and add a $3,000 credit which vests if you hit the agreed uptime and inference-volume milestone (details below). If milestone isn't hit, credit is reduced pro rata.

Performance milestone (example): 95% availability for model endpoints and >= 8k inferences/hour sustained for a 24h window. We can adjust numbers.

Next steps: let me know which option by Friday 6/18 and I'll circulate an amendment for signature. If procurement wants a PO-first flow, loop in your procurement lead and we'll provide a PO-friendly amendment and DocuSign.

Attachment: redwood-pilot-amendment-v1.pdf

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 617-555-0124
From: Elena Park <elena.park@lumenhealth.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Harris Bell <harris.bell@lumenhealth.io>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot extension and packaging options

Thanks Sofia — helpful breakdown. Two follow-ups from procurement and engineering:

- Procurement asks if the milestone credit can convert into a straight token/usage credit rather than being contingent (they prefer predictable accounting).
- Engineering wants clarity on whether the SKU-swap option changes the latency SLOs (we can't accept anything that doubles p95 latency) and whether there's any temporary concurrency surcharge during the extended run.

Looping in Harris (procurement) to share our contract process and preferred PO timeline. Harris — we often need the amendment as a short addendum with a PO and a signature.

If possible, can Redwood provide a one-page comparison that shows expected cost delta and latency expectations for the SKU-swap option? That will speed approval.

Elena

Elena / Sofia — quick note from my side. We reviewed Lumen's ask and procurement constraints. To keep the pilot moving and preserve the economics we've agreed to make a one-time exception: a three-week extension with a hybrid approach.

Concession we can offer (final):
- 3-week extension (no change to model version pinned)
- $2,000 flat credit applied immediately (applies against the pilot invoice)
- Waive the standard change/setup fee for the SKU swap if you choose to move to the lower-concurrency SKU after the extension
- No concurrency surcharge during the extension period

We can also provide a 1-page side-by-side that shows expected p95 latency and estimated token spend for the current SKU vs the lower-concurrency SKU. If Lumen is OK, we will issue amendment v2 for signature (DocuSign) and accept a PO + the standard procurement form.

Attachment: redwood-pilot-amendment-v2.pdf

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0321
